title: FloraDeck species catalogue
description: catalog/species.json. Generated by catalog/scripts/build_catalog.py; cross-checks (album sizes, one rare per album, lookalike ids) live in catalog/scripts/validate_catalog.py.

id.description: Stable kebab-case id, used by the app and by labels.json.

number.description: Card number in the species' first colour album (repeats albums[0].number).

albumId.description: The species' first colour album (repeats albums[0].albumId).

scientificName.description: Display name; for groups and genera e.g. 'Muscari sp.' or 'Viola gr. odorata'.

rarity.description: Since 2026-11-08 every album has exactly one legendary species and no rare one.

phenology.description: What the card collects, and what bloomMonths refers to.

bloomMonths.description: Months in which the collectible part is visible in Italy, from iNaturalist annotations.

altitude.description: e.g. '0–1400 m', 5th–95th percentile of observation altitudes; empty for cultivated plants.

regions.description: Where in Italy, from observations corrected for observer density.

cultivated.description: Garden and crop plants: no 'Fotografala, non raccoglierla' message.

protected.description: true = legally protected; null = possibly protected in some regions, to verify.

toxic.description: true shows a warning. false only means 'no warning': the app never claims a plant is edible.

lookalikes.description: Ids of catalogue species the model must tell apart.

lookalikesOutside.description: Scientific names outside the catalogue (learned as 'altro').

modelLabels.description: Accepted iNaturalist names that make up the model class.

albums.description: Every colour album the species belongs to, with its card number there; a legendary species has only its own album.

habitatGroup.description: Habitat group of candidates.json (texts are filed by it).
